title: Governance modal: a flow list with summary, stated effect, a check button and a close button

AC1.note: src/governance/flow-narrative.ts summarizeEffect/summarizeWork, wired in aggregate.ts; no model. flow-narrative.test.ts (stated, hint-only, no-section, empty-section, unreadable, prose/numbered after review) and report.test.ts 'flow 364 AC1' + 'review T-007' (a stored report without the fields loads and reads not recorded). CI green at 8cb9cff7.

AC2.note: renderGovernanceMarkdown prints summary: and effect: under every flow (report.ts); flow-narrative.test.ts 'AC2' asserts both lines and the not-recorded case; keryx governance --help documents it (cli.test.ts rich-help pin).

AC3.note: governance-inspector.ts opens on a Flows tab (open first, newest first) with summary and effect; up/down select and the selection is kept visible (revealSelection); Report tab kept; r re-runs. governance-inspector.test.ts 'flow 364 AC3' and the Report-tab AC3 tests; governance-flows.test.ts flowEntriesFrom.

AC4.note: evaluateCompletionGates is the one gate function complete() and checkComplete() call (service.ts); keryx flow check-complete is routed (group-subcommands.ts) and reports merge state merged/open/closed/not-found/no-pr/unknown. check-complete.test.ts: flow.json byte-identical after a passing and a failing check, a token checked not spent, complete records the same gates, merge mapping incl. direct merge and a throwing tracker, real-CLI routing. Review round 1 found complete() unchanged line by line.

AC5.note: c (and a click on the action row) runs the check for an open flow, never for a done one; the result lists merge state and every gate with its detail and a fix command (completionFixHint). governance-inspector.test.ts AC5-AC7, 'review T-005' (click), AC3 (c on done does nothing); check-complete.test.ts AC5 hints.

AC6.note: closeOffer: only on a passing check of a merged PR (or verified direct merge), not older than the listed flow; d asks for the id typed back, any other key cancels; confirmation-required flows are pointed at keryx flow confirm. Enter re-checks the live flow first. governance-flows.test.ts closeOffer cases; governance-inspector.test.ts AC5-AC7, 'review L-001' (id 312), 'review L-003', 'review round 2'.

AC7.note: runClose shows the real flow complete result (closed, or each failed gate) and re-runs the report (runner.start). governance-inspector.test.ts AC5-AC7 asserts the closed line and the report run.

AC8.note: All listed areas have tests: flow-narrative.test.ts (extraction), report.test.ts (stored-report compatibility), check-complete.test.ts (no-write, merge mapping), governance-flows.test.ts and governance-inspector.test.ts (close visibility: not done, passed, merged, stale, confirmation required; inputBlocked never checks or closes, incl. with a confirmation open). CI green at 8cb9cff7.
